stories.title: How much art do London councils own and is it locked away or on display?
stories.summary: More than 500,000 pieces of art are owned by 225 councils, the BBC finds, but most of it is storage.

stories.title: Man denies murder of woman who fell from window
stories.summary: A 55-year-old man is accused of murdering a woman who was found dead in the street in Southwark.

stories.title: Derailed wagon was dragged through Barking station
stories.summary: A derailed freight wagon was dragged for more than half a mile through an east London station.

stories.title: Two London men guilty of spying for Iran over plan to target journalists and lawyer
stories.summary: The men were convicted of engaging in conduct likely to assist an Iranian intelligence service.

stories.title: Serial Greggs shoplifter avoids jail
stories.summary: Police say they are disappointed that someone who has offended so often is back out in the community.

stories.title: DJ Tim Westwood denies two more sexual offences
stories.summary: His latest pleas of not guilty mean he now denies a total of 17 charges concerning allegations from 1983 to 2016.

stories.title: Children in Need donations improve lives with osteopathy
stories.summary: Money from Children in Need covers a thousand therapy sessions, helping to treat children including Hendrix.

stories.title: Met chief urges care over football match alcohol
stories.summary: Sir Mark Rowley says he is concerned about violence and drug abuse at football matches.

stories.title: Shot bus driver not intended target, police say
stories.summary: Detectives release CCTV footage as they track the killers of Auguste-Marie Bile-aka Amoa.

stories.title: 'We all need data, but do we need the largest data centre in Europe here?'
stories.summary: Green belt land in North Ockenden is the proposed site for a huge data centre campus, one of the largest in Europe.

stories.title: Call for employment support for people with sight loss
stories.summary: Lord Holmes says the barriers to employment include policy, funding and employer practices.

stories.title: Families of Croydon tram crash victims say justice not been done
stories.summary: Seven people died when a tram came off the tracks on a sharp bend in Croydon on 9 November 2016.
